project.name: Islanding — Restore Critical Power W/o Energizing the Fault
project.summary: Synthetic microgrid-restoration training simulator with shared human-agent state, exact human approval, and one-time execution receipts.
project.ai_usage: A WebMCP-capable agent reads state, simulates and compares plans, adapts to human priority changes, and requests an approved synthetic execution.
project.codex_usage: Research synthesis, implementation, tests, documentation, native WebMCP evaluation, and submission preparation, as documented in the project.
